calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_period, MIN(d.calendar_date) as week_start, MAX(d.calendar_date) as week_end
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_week

SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
ORDER BY category

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
AND dd.fiscal_period = 3

SELECT ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value_eur
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
AND dd.fiscal_period = 3

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  COUNT(fsw.closing_value) as non_null_values,
  MIN(fsw.closing_value) as min_value,
  MAX(fsw.closing_value) as max_value,
  AVG(fsw.closing_value) as avg_value,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) as avg_value_rounded
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
